# Pinned reference files from PR #7

These files are copied without modification from Zhihao Chen (jacklightChen)'s
[ternary five-subset contribution](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7)
at commit `6725c6a17b17871a35353fd29157f4ed851bc114`.
[provenance.json](../provenance.json) records original paths and SHA-256 hashes.

The paired degree-three circuit, full-support C++ checker, replacement template
exporter, and small rational/scalar controls are their contribution. The copied
certificate records the original conditional witness, not this follow-up.
These files use the repository's [Apache-2.0 license](../../../LICENSE).

Their construction builds on Douglas Colkitt's framework, Bortlesboat's aligned
pairing, dleen's retained totals and stage sharing, and eumemic's complex
compression, faster Gaussian resampling, and cheaper centers. See the pinned
PR #7 proof note and NOTICE for its full attribution. This follow-up retains
that provenance and makes no worldwide priority claim.
